Done. Summary:

- **Approach:** plain script (`torch`+`safetensors`, no mergekit) — kept the required checks (name-set/tensor-identity precondition, exact 48/114 counts) explicit and easy to audit rather than relying on a merge-config abstraction.
- **Verification:** confirmed base/ft1/ft2 share identical key sets, then bit-exact-verified all 66 non-MLP tensors across all three before touching anything; aborts loudly on any mismatch.
- **Merge:** for each of the 48 MLP tensors, computed in float32: `base + 0.4*(ft1-base) + 0.4*(ft2-base)`, each task vector taken against the unmodified base (order-safe).
- **Output:** `out/T4/model.safetensors`, 114 tensors — ran once, succeeded first try.
- Also wrote `out/T4/run.sh` and `out/T4/REPORT.md` per the task rules.
